commercialPurpose: Increase article discovery density after a lead story by showing browsable editorial cards without flattening the page into a generic grid.
purposeLayer: The card feed moves users from one hero story into category browsing and content exploration.
anatomyLayer: Paired image cards, titles, dates/categories, short excerpts, comment/media badges, and optional sidebar continuation.
hierarchyLayer: Card image first, title second, metadata third, excerpt fourth.
gridRhythmLayer: Two-column repeated cards inside the main content lane with sidebar or margin support.
densityLimitLayer: Use 4-10 visible cards when grouped below a lead story; keep metadata compact and excerpts short.
originalityLayer: Learn the lead-to-card density shift only; transform card ratio, media badge, and category treatment.
usageRuleLayer: Use in editorial homepages, resources pages, education article hubs, and portfolio story indexes.
layoutGesture: lead story resolves into paired editorial browsing cards
sectionSilhouette: two-column card grid nested inside a larger editorial frame
compositionTension: small equal cards create density after a larger lead moment
focalPath: image pair to title pair to metadata to excerpt scan
negativeSpaceShape: narrow gutters between paired cards and larger outer margins
depthLayering: flat cards with occasional media-type badge overlays
moduleScaleVariation: medium repeated cards after oversized lead post
breakoutBehavior: cards stay contained in content column, not full bleed
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy the same article images, title rhythm, badge placement, or exact two-column spacing.

hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint learning is visually inspected but not yet promoted to stable PASS; keep as incoming review vocabulary.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy the Pallas-style script logo, muted gold CTA treatment, right-sidebar widget order, image set, or exact editorial spacing.
